quotes.text: nsMsgSearchDBView opens a tree update batch in OnNewSearch and closes it in OnSearchDone. This prevents an update for every message hit while the synthetic results list fills. Bug 1896913 measured about 12 to 4 seconds for roughly 800 results in a debug build; the exact timing is historical and workload-specific. The pattern came from nsMsgXFVirtualFolderDBView and remains in current code. Keep begin/end paired, including completion paths, if search lifecycle changes.
